climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: An AVA covering the islands of Martha's Vineyard and Chappaquiddick off the Massachusetts coast, set within Southeastern New England. Its 1985 creation was contested by a Napa Valley vineyard of the same name. The maritime location gives a slightly warmer climate and a growing season almost three weeks longer than nearby coastal Massachusetts.
